title: Use asymmetric interference only after making the observation/protection contract explicit
statement: For perfectly observed unfinished setS and protected successes, V(S)=max_(j inS) k_jj*V(S\j)/[k_jj+w_j+sum_(i inS\j)k_ij+sum_(i inS)d_i]. Under the declared linear normalized clocks, mixing donors while waiting cannot exceed the best pure-donor Bellman ratio.

assumptions: Hypothetical rates and numerical long-programme tables are not chemical measurements or an integrated relay. Covalent attachment is not local register or amide-specific completion. Local Gaussian contact is a model, not universal polymer kinetics. Rolling active anchors do not eliminate injury from every retained obsolete handle; multiplying survival factors requires actual independence.
costs: Pay actual complete source/instrument/preparation/chemistry/control contracts and every attempt, failed pulse, wash, report, rejected object, retained handle, settling interval and physical qualification. Exact finite enumeration is exponential where stated. Supplied rates, independence, bounds, structural laws and synthetic model centres are not acquired by fitting or hashing. Equal-information ordinary methods can tie.
contract.units: Rate coefficients need declared concentration normalization; clock hazards in inverse time, exposure in time, hazard ratios/probabilities dimensionless. Contact density is inverse volume and is not itself a chemical rate. Illustrative seconds and programme lengths are model parameters.
contract.obstruction: Acquire/warrant the actual full physical/statistical/causal interface before use beyond this conditional model. Missing original companions remain unacquired, not reconstructed from tables. No new producer replay, physical measurement, working device, integrated manufacturing/developmental capability, historical priority or practical advantage. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

body: Ratios of affine positive mixtures are bounded by their best vertex; induction gives the recurrence. Protection removes completed lineages before the dangerous donor arrives. Directed cycles can retain a fidelity penalty. This optimistic controller is not supplied by the chemical relay; source open-loop numeric schedules have missing original code/data and remain reports. Active donor carryover, persistent competence and whole-product aging are separate costs.
